description: This file is a jQuery Image Cropping Plugin (jquery.Jcrop.js), which provides functionality to select and crop regions of an image via an interactive interface, including handling user interactions like dragging and resizing, as well as visual effects and configuration options.
external_files: jquery (implicitly, as it depends on jQuery)

methods.name: Jcrop
methods.description: Main constructor function for initializing the image cropping interface on a target element.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Method to load and set a new image for cropping.

methods.name: animateTo
methods.description: Animates the cropping rectangle to a specified position.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Updates configuration options for the cropping interface.

methods.name: tellSelect
methods.description: Returns the current selection rectangle as an array of coordinates.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the cropping interface and restores the original image.
